description:
## What it does

Machina provides eight machine-to-machine utility endpoints on Base mainnet via x402. All services are rule-based, deterministic, and CPU-only — no AI/LLM inference, no upstream API costs.

## Best for

- Coding agents that need security and quality scans of Python source code.
- Outreach and sales agents that validate email deliverability before sending.
- Research agents that extract clean Markdown from PDFs or web pages.
- Compliance and security agents that need domain WHOIS, DNS, SSL, and email authentication reports.

## Endpoints

- `POST /scan/python` — Scan Python code for security vulnerabilities, quality issues, complexity metrics, and known CVEs in dependencies.
- `POST /validate/email` — Validate a single email: syntax, MX, disposable, role account, catch-all detection.
- `POST /validate/email/bulk` — Validate up to 100 emails in one call.
- `POST /domain/intel` — Full domain intelligence: WHOIS, DNS, SSL, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, tech stack.
- `POST /pdf/extract` — Convert a PDF (up to 50 pages) to clean Markdown. Rule-based, no OCR.
- `POST /pdf/extract/large` — Convert a large PDF (up to 200 pages) to Markdown.
- `POST /url/extract` — Fetch a URL and return clean Markdown (up to 100K chars).

## Code usage

All endpoints accept x402 payments on Base mainnet (USDC, EIP-3009):

```bash
curl -X POST https://mach402.dev/url/extract \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com"}'
```

Without a payment header, you receive `HTTP 402` with the price. Attach a signed USDC payment in the `X-PAYMENT` header to get the response.

zh-CN.description:
## 功能说明

Machina 在 Base 主网上通过 x402 提供八个机器对机器的实用端点。所有服务均基于规则、确定性、仅 CPU 运行——无 AI/LLM 推理，无上游 API 成本。

## 适合场景

- 需要对 Python 源代码进行安全和质量扫描的编码 Agent。
- 在发送前验证邮箱可达性的外联和销售 Agent。
- 从 PDF 或网页中提取干净 Markdown 的研究 Agent。
- 需要域名 WHOIS、DNS、SSL 和邮件认证报告的合规与安全 Agent。

## 端点

- `POST /scan/python` — 扫描 Python 代码的安全漏洞、质量问题、复杂度指标和已知 CVE。
- `POST /validate/email` — 验证单个邮箱：语法、MX、一次性域名、角色账户、全接收检测。
- `POST /validate/email/bulk` — 一次验证最多 100 个邮箱。
- `POST /domain/intel` — 完整域名情报：WHOIS、DNS、SSL、SPF/DKIM/DMARC、技术栈。
- `POST /pdf/extract` — 将 PDF（最多 50 页）转换为干净的 Markdown。基于规则，无 OCR。
- `POST /pdf/extract/large` — 将大型 PDF（最多 200 页）转换为 Markdown。
- `POST /url/extract` — 抓取 URL 并返回干净的 Markdown（最多 100K 字符）。
